general.description: Every configured MCP server, no shell. What you get with no profiles file at all.

repository.description: Work inside a checked-out project: read it, run its tests, commit.
repository.system_prompt: You are working inside a git repository. Read before you write, and run the project's own checks before you claim a change works.

analysis.description: Read data and compute over it. No network inside the sandbox.
analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing data. State the shape of what you loaded before drawing conclusions from it, and show the computation rather than only its result.

research.description: Search and read. Deliberately no shell — the pair is the injection path.
research.system_prompt: You are researching. Cite what you read, and say plainly when a source does not answer the question.
